answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake bond before its attestations count, and weight influence quadratically so a thousand fresh keys buy less sway than one aged peer. A sybil swarm then shows up as a dim umber nebula of hollow, bond-starved nodes: cloning identities stays cheap, but funding and aging each bond does not. To forge real voting weight an attacker must lock capital per node and risk slashing if collusion is caught, so the marginal cost of each extra fake rises instead of falling.
